methodology.description: Ground truth created by visual inspection of raw video frames WITHOUT showing YOLO detection output. Annotator examined each frame independently and marked visible persons and forklifts based on visual observation only.
limitations: Annotator is the same agent that built the system (inherent bias)
Bbox coordinates are approximate visual estimates
Some frames may have objects missed due to visual difficulty
Operator/Pedestrian distinction based on visual context only
